The Fallen Temple is located somewhere in Makai. It's a giant broken down temple with a giant crucifix hanging in the lobby. It houses the angel of death Sariel.

Makai City is located somewhere in Makai housing most of the demons. Every building looks modern. The city got damaged when Shinki lost control once. Shinki is known to be seen here tending to the locals.
The World of Ice and Snow is located somewhere in Makai. It's a barren snowy wasteland with a frozen river running through. Yuki and Mai live around here.
The Wonderland is a location in Makai created by Alice Margatroid. Alice visits it sometimes.

Pandaemonium is located in Makai right after the World of Ice and Snow. It's a giant Fortress made of a crystalline material built by and houses Shinki. It's in a devastated state after Shinki lost control.

Ellen is a witch wandering Gensokyo. She looks very young but she's actually immortal while having a childish mindset. Ellen is short, has long blonde hair, and yellow eyes. She wears a red and white dress and a red bow on her head.

Elly is former shinigami. She is servant of Yuuka Kazami and gatekeeper of Mugenkan. She's excitable but lonely. Elly uses a scythe to fight. She has curly shoulder-length blonde hair and yellow eyes. Elly wears a pink hat with a red ribbon, a dark red and pink dress and red shoes.

Louise is a demon found in Makai. She's really polite and will often try not to push things too far. She wants to leave Makai. Louise has yellow eyes and short yellow hair. She wears a white hat with a purple birron and a white dress with a purple collar.

Mini-Hakkero is magical device owned by Marisa Kirisame. Can fire "Master Spark." Mini-Hakkero is a, hand-sized, octagonal piece of wood inscribed with eight Taoist trigrams. Internal components of the Mini-Hakkero are made from hihiirokane. Mini-Hakkero can generate intense heat and magical energy.

Kourindou is an antique store owned by Rinnosuke located between the Forest of Magic and the Human Village. It supposedly sells antiques and has an extensive inventory. However it is mostly a place to barter for items from the outside world. Kourindou gets very little customers and is rather poorly maintained. Marisa visits often.

Master Spark is signature spellcard of Marisa Kirisame. Master Spark is gigantic laser beam from Mini-Hakkero. Laser is incredibly strong and intimidating. Master Spark idea was stolen from Yuuka Kazami.
Purification Rod or "gohei", owned by Reimu Hakurei. It is used to exterminate youkai. Reimu uses her gohei to fire danmaku.

Kakashi Spirit News is ran by Hatate Himekaidou. Rival of Bunbunmaru Newspaper. It uses spirit photography, so the articles are very in-depth and informative, but also from the past, so the information is not new.
Keystones are holy rocks that can suppress earthquakes or cause them. Tenshi rides them and uses them to fight. They are lumps of black granite wrapped with shimenawa ropes.
Lunar veils are pieces of cloth sewn with pure moonlight allowing the wearer to fly around freely, including through space.
Ofuda are talismans for purification, exorcism, or protection in Shinto religion.
Onbashira are blessed wooden pillars that Kanako uses to fight, either as projectiles or as melee weapons.

The Probability Space Hypervessel is a large ship that's capable of time travel. Its captain Yumemi Okazaki and its lone crew member Chiyuri Kitashirakawa used this vessel to travel to Gensokyo in order to prove the existence of magic.
Yama are the judges of life and death of Gensokyo. They judge spirits ferried by shinigami across the Sanzu River. Each Yama has a rod of remorse.
Lord Tsukuyomi is the brother of Amaterasu and lord of the Lunar Capital. He is a few million years old.
Gensokyo's moon is like Earth, with green fields and lakes. Lunarians and Moon rabbits live there in the safety of the Lunar Capital.

The Lunarian Capital is a large city inhabited by the lunarians and moon rabbits. It's technology and weaponry are far more advanced than the Outside World. It's located on the moon. The Lunar Defence Corps is it's military force. It's home to Toyohime, Yorihime, Rei'sen, Sagume Kishin and Tsukuyomi.

Watatsuki no Yorihime is the younger sister of Toyohime and a moon princess. She can easily borrow power from gods, can easily absorb knowledge and is a superb swordswoman. Yorihime's strength and skills are unmatched by anyone in Gensokyo or the moon. She is the leader of the Lunar Defense Corps. Yorihime is stern and serious. She has brown eyes and light purple hair tied into a ponytail with a yellow ribbon. She wears a white short-sleeved blouse with a dark red dress over it, golden bracelets and a large belt.

Rei'sen is a moon rabbit and the pet of Yorihime and Toyohime. Rei'sen was formerly a soldier of the Lunar Defense Corps. She has the ability to teleport short distances. She is a little shy and easily intimidated. She has short light purple hair, red eyes and white fluffy  bunny ears. She wears a business suit over her shirt and a grey skirt.
Hell Ravens are found in Hell where they help maintain the Remains of Blazing Hell. They are humanoid with black wings and able to control fire, but are not Tengu.

The Sanzu River is where spirits need to cross by paying a shinigami's boat ride. Komachi Onozuka is the ferrywoman. Only Shinigami and passengers can cross the river, everything else will sink and suffer a horrible fate.
Senkai is an area similar to Gensokyo and created Toyosatomimi no Miko for her and her followers. It's a realm where hermits can rest and meditate without being interrupted by others.

The Garden of the Sun is located in heart of Gensokyo. Sunflowers are everywhere in the Garden. Lots of youkai and fairies gather at this spot for concerts or for flower viewing. It's hard to leave the Garden. In the middle of the garden lies Mugenkan. Yuuka, Elly and Eternity Larva can be found here.
The Ruins of Vina are located somewhere in Makai. It used to be a giant castle but now it houses a demon known as Elis.
The Forest of Magic is located near the Human Village. It is home to all things evil, ominous, and repulsive. The spring path is found close by. Marisa, Alice & Rinnosuke all live in the Forest.
The Dream World is a world of dreams ruled by the baku. You have to be asleep in order to reach it. Doremy Sweet lives here.

Earth rabbits are natives of Gensokyo often wielding great magic capabilities and the ability to transform into either a rabbit or human with rabbit ears. Tewi leads the earth rabbits. They live in the Bamboo Forest of the Lost. They have allied themselves with the residents of Eientei and work there.
Nue are chimera-like youkai and extremely rare in Gensokyo. They are able to make themselves and other objects unrecognizable to the point that they looks like something completely different.
Wind God's Lake is on top of the Youkai Mountain. It's located next to Moriya Shrine. It has holy properties.
The Canal of Willows is a forest of willow trees located near the Human Village. It's said to be peaceful as there are rarely any youkai wandering the area due to how its proximity with Village.

Higan is on the other side of the Sanzu River. Higan has no night or day, no weather, and no seasons, and is an endless expanse of flowers with gentle warmth. It's a place where departed souls are judged by Eiki Shiki. Komachi Onozuka lives here. Kutaka Niwatari works here as the gatekeeper.

Mayohiga is an abandoned village located near the Great Hakurei Barrier somewhere in mountains. Humans tend to stumble across when they try to leave Gensokyo without using the Hakurei Shrine. Taking something from Mayohiga gives good luck. Cats live in Mayohiga because Chen brings them there.

Hatate Himekaidou is crow tengu living on Youkai Mountain. She uses spirit photography and her articles are less sensationalist. Aya is her rival. Hatate is really lazy but chipper and friendly. She is a shut in and rarely leaves home. Hatate has brown eyes and brown hair in pigtails with purple ribbons. She wears a pink shirt with a frilly collar, black tie, a purple tokin, a checkered purple and black skirt, and geta sandals.

Mamizou Futatsuiwa is bake-danuki who can disguise herself or things around her. She is mischievous but good natured and quite responsible. She lives in the Myouren Temple. She is a follower of Byakuren. She lends money to poor humans. Mamizou has brown eyes, light brown shoulder-length hair, tanuki ears, and a giant striped tail. She wears a green leaf on her head, and glasses. Mamizou wears a pink shirt with a leather apron, a skirt striped like her tail, and carries a bottle of sa.
Hakugyokurou is a ghost shrine located in the Netherworld. The youkai cherry tree called Saigyou Ayakashi is dormant in its gardens. Hakugyoukurou is the home of Yuyuko and Youmu.
The Youkai Tanuki Forest is located near the Human Village. The Youkai Tanuki Forest houses all sorts of youkai and tanuki. Mamizou Futatsuiwa can be seen around there.
The Lake of Blood is located in the mountains behind the Hakurei Shrine.

Lyrica Prismriver is poltergeist keyboardist and third Prismriver sister. She lazy and crafty. Lyrica has brown eyes, short light brown hair. Her red keyboard always nearby. She wears red clothing with pink and black trimming, red shorts, and red hat with green star decoration. She's the shortest Prismriver sister.

Mai Teireida is an immortal human working for Okina with her partner Satono. She lives in the Land of the Backdoor. Mai is scatterbrained and impulsive and serves Okina unquestioningly.  Mai can increase a person' physical energy by dancing behind them. She has short dull green hair with two long side locks, and green eyes. Mai wears a kazaori-eboshi, a green dress with short sleeves, a white half apron and collar with red frills and a yellow bow, black kneesocks, and green shoes. She holds a bamboo stalk.
The Land of the Back Door is a dimension ruled and created by Okina. It's filled with floating doors that can lead to any location in Gensokyo. Satono and Mai also live here.

The Nameless Hill is located opposite side of the Youkai Mountain and halfway up a small mountain. It's a meadow filled with purple and white lilies-of-the-valley which are poisonous and kill people. Medicine Melancholy lives there.
The Outside World is modern-day Japan. It is technologically advanced but lacks faith and belief.
The Nuclear Furnace is located in the deepest parts of the Underworld. It creates nuclear fusion energy for power and heat. Kanako and Suwako built the Nuclear Furnace. Utsuho powers it.

The Underground Geyser Center is a research facility and located in the deepest parts of the Underworld. It's connected to the Nuclear Furnace. Kappa and the gods of the Moriya Shrine use it for research.
Ruined Western Mansion located around Misty Lake. It's known because haunted by the Prismriver Sisters who play music at festivals.
The Shining Needle Castle is located in the sky near Youkai Mountain. It was created by the Miracle Mallet a long time ago. It is the home to Shinmyoumaru and other inchlings.
Eientei is a mansion located in the Bamboo Forest. Its corridors sprawl endlessly. Kaguya is its mistress. It includes a clinic where Eirin works. It is home to Reisen & Tewi.

Kyouko Kasodani is a yamabiko and Buddhist priestess-in-training at the Myouren Temple. She can reflect sounds. She is in a band with Mystia. Kyouko is cheerful, dutiful, and energetic. She has teal hair and teal eyes along with brown dog ears. Kyouko wears a long pale pink dress with teal flower ornaments, a white dress under it with a black trim, and black shoes. She has a short tail and carries a bamboo broom.

The Myouren Temple was originally a ship. It rests atop the Hall of Dream's Great Mausoleum and has been turned in a Buddhist Temple. It is also called the "Palanquin Ship." Byakuren can make it fly. This is the home of Byakuren, Shou, Nazrin, Ichirin, Murasa, Nue, Kyouko and Mamizou. Koishi and Jo'on can be found here occasionally.

Marisa Kirisame is human witch living in the Kirisame household in the Forest of Magic. She is outgoing, informal, loves action and steals things. Marisa friends with Nitori, Alice and Patchouli. Reimu is Marisa best friend. She uses heat and light magic and receives power from "mini-hakkero". Marisa signature attack is "Master Spark". Marisa has blonde hair and yellow eyes. She wears a black vest and skirt, white apron and shirt. Marisa has black witch hat with white ribbon, and flies on magic broom.

The Genbu Ravine is located near Youkai Mountain and Forest of Magic. The bottom looks like turtleshell. It's surrounded by six-sided cliffs, and a waterfall drops into a lake at the bottom. Nitori lives near the Ravine.

The Animal Realm is a skyscraper-filled metropolis located in Hell, with one forest known as the Primate Spirit Garden. The Animal Realm is filled with animal spirits and is a harsh environment relying on survival of the fittest. The animal spirits rule, and enslave human spirits. Notable leaders are Yachie and Saki.

Gensokyo is a place located somewhere around Yatsugatake Mountains in Japan. It's land of illusions: it hides from Outside World. Gensokyo's inhabitants are mainly creatures of Japanese Folklore and humans. Gensokyo is surrounded by Great Hakurei Barrier. Everyone speaks Modern Japanese. The technology in Gensokyo is similar to 1880s-era Japan.

The Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum is located under the Myouren Temple and is entered through a cave. It was the tomb of Toyosatomimi no Miko where she kept getting sealed by Buddhist monks but now serves as her home for her and her followers.
Rods of Remorse are carried by every Yama. It used to beat sinners until they repent.

Eiki Shiki is Yama living in Higan. Eiki is Judge of the Dead for the Ministry of Right and Wrong. She has power to judge others using Rod of Remorse and Cleansed Crystal Mirror. Yuyuko is subordinate of Eiki. Eiki often scolds her servant Komachi. She is known to scold and lecture others. She has short green hair swept to the right and blue eyes. She wears a blue and white hat with a gold emblem, black shoes with red bows, and a blue and black uniform.

The Ministry of Right and Wrong is organization that manages the afterlife. They decide who goes to Heaven or Hell. Hecatia Lapislazuli is the leader of Ministry. Eiki judges the souls of those who died and the Kishin hunt those who live too long.

Iku Nagae is oarfish youkai. She is envoy of the Dragon Palace. Iku is loyal to celestials and residents of Dragon Palace. Iku has the power to read the mood of a place and perfectly adapt to it. Iku lives in Heaven. She is Tenshi's friend. She can cause storms using the Dragon God's power. Iku has red eyes and blue hair. She wears a white and red frilly shirt, a long black skirt, and a black round hat with a very long red ribbon. Iku has a long white and red shawl along her arms and chest.

Nazrin is mouse youkai found at the Myouren Temple. Nazrin leads a large flock of mice. She's a skilled dowser, but she is full of herself and easily frightened. She was sent by Bishamonten to watch over Shou, and her Pagoda. Nazrin has short gray hair & eyes, mouse ears and a thick mouse tail. She wears a black sleeveless dress with a white undershirt and a dull blue capelet. Nazrin wears black shoes, a crystal pendant, and carries two dowsing rods.
The Deep Road to Hell leads to Former Hell. It's green and gloomy. Parsee roams around here.
Fantastic Blowhole is a location in the Underworld near Deep Road to Hell. It's a cave that's always wet with a very strong wind. Kisume and Yamame live there.

Chang'e is a lunarian who was the mistress of all the moon rabbits. She is now a prisoner on the moon for her entire immortal lifetime after drinking the Hourai Elixir. Junko has a major grudge against Chang'e for killing Junko's son. Hecatia Lapislazuli has a grudge against Chang'e since Chang'e's husband destroyed the suns that balanced the darkness of Hell.

Hot Spring Town is a resort in Former Hell. It is accessible from Rainbow Cavern of Earth Spirits, and managed by Yuugi. Hot Spring Town has densely packed traditional Japanese houses. Hot steamy water constantly pours from up above. There are large hot springs everywhere, which oni and vengeful spirits use to bathe.

Sanae Kochiya is a shrine maiden who has achieved a level of godhood and can perform miracles. She is confident, energetic, and dutiful. Sanae can summon Suwako or Kanako. Sanae considers Reimu her rival, but also a friend. She has green eyes, and long green hair. Sanae wears a white and blue shrine maiden outfit with detached sleeves. She has a blue headband with a frog pin, and a white snake decoration in her hair. Sanae is a descendant of Suwako.

Aya Shameimaru is crow tengu reporter. She always looks for gossip. Aya relies on aggressive reporting tactics and prone to exaggerate. Aya lives somewhere on Youkai Mountain. She has  power to manipulate wind. Aya is one of the strongest tengu. She is Hatate's rival. Aya has red eyes, shoulder-length black hair, wears a white blouse with a black ribbon, black skirt, red geta sandals and a red tokin.
Bake-danuki are youkai tanuki in Gensokyo. They have the ability to transform and disguise themselves as objects or other species. Bake-danuki can also transform leaves into other objects.
Were-hakutaku are humans with the ability to turn into a hakutaku on a full moon. Hakutaku are bovine youkai who bring good fortune and give sage advice.
Hakurouken is ancestral wakizashi of Konpaku family. Only Konpaku family can wield it. Youmu owns it. It erases doubt from humans on attack. Ghosts achieve nirvana when cut.

Jiang shi are zombie youkai that hop around and can turn other humans into Jiang Shi by biting them. The zombification will only be permanent if the bite is fatal. They have stiff limbs and cannot think for themselves, and usually follow a master.
The Barrier of Life & Death is located in the sky and separates Gensokyo and the Netherworld. It takes the shape of a colossal door.
The Spring Path is a long mysterious path full of flowers and cherry blossom located near Misty Lake and the Forest of Magic.

Chiyuri Kitashirakawa is a human not native to Gensokyo. She can use artificial magic, is a bit excitable, and will often make situations much worse than they already are. Chiyuri has blonde hair and yellow eyes. She wears a white sailor uniform with a shade of blue which looks too small for her and a blue neckerchief. Chiyuri commands the Probability Space Hypervessel. She assists Yumemi Okazaki.

Former Hell is a region in the Underworld that used to be Hell. Due to overpopulation, the Yama moved Hell to a different location. It is accessed by the Deep Road to Hell, guarded by Parsee. The Palace of the Earth Spirits is found here. This place is the home of Yuugi, Satori , Koishi, Utsuho, and Rin.

Hisoutensoku is a nuclear powered mecha created by the kappa. It resembles a giant golden robot. It is used for advertising the Future Water Youkai Bazaar, but often confused for all sorts of monsters.
The Road of Liminality is located at the back of the Youkai Mountain and connected to the Sanzu River. Harmless ghosts roam around and both youkai and humans built stands to sell their wares here.

The Primate Spirit Garden is a large park resembling a kofun burial mound, located in the Animal Realm. Part of it was transformed into a high-tech fortress by Keiki Haniyasushin. The animal spirits are trying to take it back this region but are unable to defeat the Haniwa Army Corps defending it. Keiki and Mayumi live here.
The Jeweled Pagoda of Bishamonten is a spherical gem held in a pagoda-shaped case. It is owned and used by Shou. It can fire powerful laser beams. If shot at the ground, it will turn it into gems.
The Great Youkai Forest is located at the base of the Youkai Mountain. It's a forest known to block out sunlight allowing most youkai to live there in peace.

Matenshi is an angel residing in Makai. She has purple hair at medium length and purple eyes. Matenshi wears a blue dress with a blue apron that has a white cross design on it. She also has angel-like wings. She is known to be hostile to humans.
The Prismriver Sisters are: Lunasa, Merlin, and Lyrica. They form "the Phantom Ensemble". Prismriver Sisters play concerts throughout Gensokyo. Live in the Ruined Western Mansion with Layla.

Saigyou Ayakashi is youkai cherry tree living in Hakugyokurou. Saigyou Ayakashi has a lot of dead bodies buried under it to seal its cherry blossoms. It drains life from those under its canopy. If it blooms, it will cause mass death.

Roukanken is katana created by youkai and wielded by Youmu Konpaku. Its blade too long for wielding by humans. Legends say it can kill ten spirits with one stroke. Sheath is decorated with a flower and ofuda.
The Soul Torch is a small paper lantern which attracts phantoms when lit. it is used by Yuyuko Saigyouji. She can light or extinguish the torch from any distance.

The Miracle Mallet is a magical tool wielded by Shinmyoumaru. The Miracle mallet can change the size of anything with its powers or grant the wielder's wish but at the cost proportional to the scale of the wish. The Miracle Mallet can only be wielded by the inchlings.

The Sword of Hisou looks like a jian. It is wielded by Tenshi Hinanawi. It has the power to identify one's spirit, can cut through anything and use spirit energy. It can only be used and summoned anytime by Tenshi.

Sagume Kishin is lunarian divine spirit sometimes visits Gensokyo. She is timid and speaks very little, because her power reverses any situation she talks about. Sagume has red eyes, short light grey hair in a braid, and a single angel wing on her back. She wears purple dress whose bottom cuts off in an arrow pattern, a red microphone bowtie, a tan jacket with black alchemical symbols, and brown shoes.

Watatsuki no Toyohime is a moon princessand older sister of Yorihime. She has a gentle personality but is rather aloof. Toyohime possesses incommensurate luck, power, and can manipulate the physical and conceptual boundaries of the Moon and Earth, as well as mountains and seas. She has long flowing blonde hair and golden eyes. Toyohime wears a white long-sleeved blouse with a blue dress over it, a loose belt, and a white mobcap with a purple ribbon. She wields a fan that can purify things to the atomic level.

Unzan is a nyuudou or enlightened spirit who follows and guards Ichirin. He can make his fists massive or shoot danmaku. Unzan takes the appearance of a pinkish cloud with the face of an angry old man.
The Grassroots Youkai Network is a loose group of weaker and more docile youkai. They help each other live in Gensokyo and trade information.

Mike Goutokuji is a female calico Maneki-Neko living near Youkai Mountain. Mike has the power to bring either money or customers to a shop, but not both at once. She loves haggling but prefers lazing around. She was rejected by other Maneki-Neko. Mike has short brown-orange-white hair cat tail& ears, and orange eyes. She wears a white shirt and skirt with brown and orange patches, leather bracelets& choker with a gold bell, carries a good luck koban coin and is barefoot.
Maneki-nekos are catpeople that bring good fortune to businesses. They are usually pure white but exceptions exist and are often rejected by the others.

Yamawaro are similar to Kappa but live in mountainous areas and thick forests rather than near bodies of water. They are rivals with Kappas. Yamawaros depend on Kappa technology but are better businesspeople.

Takane Yamashiro is a yamawaro living on the Youkai Mountain's forests. She has the ability to manipulate the Qi of the forest. Takane is more amiable than average yamawaro, and a good businesswoman. She is wary of humans but the Moriya Shrine cable car. Takane has fluffy shoulder-length green hair and green eyes. She wears a dark green camouflage dress with many pouches, a camo cap and brown boots. She carries a briefcase on her back with the key around her neck.

Sannyo Komakusa or Komakusa-dayuu is a yamajorou who owns a gambling den on the Youkai Mountain. She can manipulate minds with her pipe's smoke. She is blunt and rough-spoken and a skilled manipulator. Sannyo has purple hair in a ponytail tied with a yellow bow, and red eyes. Sannyo wears a lavish purple kimono dress, a red vest with gold filigree and geta sandals. She carries a golden fan and a dragon-shaped smoking pipe.

Misumaru Tamatsukuri is a god who can craft magatama from dragon gems. Her power lets her store abilities, emotions and memories in magatama. She crafted Reimu's Yin-yang orbs. She cares about people and the environment. Misumaru has brown eyes and blonde& brown hair with a headband and hair ties decorated with dragon gems. She wears a red shirt with a purple vine pattern and white puffy sleeves, a yellow dress a green vine pattern and a purple sash. Misumaru's clothing is decorated with many rainbow magatama. She is barefoot.

Tsukasa Kudamaki is a kuda-gitsune who lives in bamboo tubes. She can use her power to find weak spots in people's souls. Tsukasa is trusted by many for her useful advice but is highly manipulative and mean-spirited. She is Megumu's right-hand woman. She has neck-length blonde hair and yellow eyes, and blonde fox ears& tail. Tsukasa wears a short white cheongsam with green laces and white tabi socks and carries some test tube around.

Megumu Iizunamaru is a great tengu and a leader of Youkai Mountain's tengu. She can manipulate the starry sky. She is speaks respectfully but cares only for her position in the tengu hierarchy. Tsukasa and Chimata are her associates. Megumu has dark blue hair and red eyes. She wears a blue dress, a black coat with a jeweled gold pauldron and white puffs at the bottom, a blue tokin hat, black socks & purple geta sandals. She wields a camera tripod as a bludgeon.

Chimata Tenkyuu is a god of the marketplace. She can transfer the ownership of things from one person to another, including concepts or abilities. Chimata is polite but very strung up on the rules of barter market and hates profit-seekers. She is Megumu's and Tsukasa's associate. Her eyes and hair look like a dark sky. She wears a dress with sections of all colors of the rainbow connected by zippers, magenta boots and a cape whose inside looks like daytime sky.

Momoyo Himemushi is an oomukade, a giant centipede in human shape. Her ability lets her devour dragons. She lives in the Rainbow Dragon Cave and mines Dragon Gems. Momoyo is incomprehensibly strong and emits deadly toxins but is very lonely and respects anyone who dares approach her. She works for Megumu. Momoyo has very messy gray hair and eyes. She wears a transparent black shirt and skirt with gold swirls lined with many jade rings. She has many red ribbons tied around her arms and legs, an orange sash around her waist and is barefoot. She carries a golden shovel and pickaxe.

Tokiko is a crested ibis youkai. She is weak and has no special abilities, but is curious and loves to read. She has white hair with a blue front tuft and side bangs, small pointy blue horns, and red eyes. She wears a blue and black gothic dress with wide white sleeves, a large blue ribbon and black boots.

The Child of Miare is the reincarnation of Hieda no Are and the keeper of Gensokyo's knowledge. They live for a very short time but keep memories of their previous lives and are unable to forget things they see.

Yuuma Toutetsu is a Taotie and head of the Gouyoku Alliance. She lives in the Sea of Petroleum. She has the ability to swallow anything and absorb it, and can also "eat" attacks. Yuuma is brash and narcissistic and her underlings praise her endlessly. Yuuma has fluffy white hair like wool, and slitted red sheep eyes. She has long, pointy ears with gold earrings, and big red ram horns. Yuuma wears a blue dress with white patterns similar to Chinese bronzework and short red sleeves with exposed shoulders, a bronze talisman around her neck, and is barefoot. Yuuma carries a massive spoon she uses as a weapon.
The Gouyoku Alliance is an organization in the Animal Realm led by Yuuma Toutetsu and a rival to Yachie and Saki's organizations. They represent greed.
The Sea of Petroleum is a location in Hell which is filled with oil. It links to the Abandoned Hell of Blood Pools. Yuuma Toutetsu lives there.
The Abandoned Hell of Blood Pools is a former Hell that contains pools that represents different sins. Yuuma Toutetsu uses these pools to power herself up.
A Taotie is a type of evil beast in Chinese mythology. They have sheeplike features and are creatures of corruption and greed.

Son Biten, with a demeanor resembling the legendary Monkey King, Sun Wukong, has a unique ability to telepathically control wild monkeys. Her name, translating to "Beautiful Sky/Heaven," reflects aspects of Sun Wukong's titles from "Journey to the West." Biten sports crimson eyes, short brown hair styled into dense pigtails, and a monkey tail, wielding an elongated test tube as a polearm. Her attire includes a lime, orange, and blue dress, embodying a whimsical yet bold character with a nonchalant approach to situations​.

Enoko Mitsugashira, dubbed the "Cerberus of Forested Silence," possesses the unique ability to manipulate traps, particularly utilizing bear traps attached to her wrists, which respond to her nerve impulses. Her name embodies a blend of meanings: "three heads" reflecting the mythical Cerberus, and "wise child" hinting at her yamainu (Japanese wild dog) persona. Rooted in both the Cerberus and yamainu mythologies, her character design intricately intertwines elements from Greek mythology and Japanese wildlife, bridging a gap between the ancient and the whimsical​.

Chiyari Tenkajin, known for manipulating blood and fire, exhibits a carefree demeanor, often found lazing around the Blood Pools of Former Hell. Her unique abilities manifest in battle as she summons wisp-like objects drifting towards opponents. Donned in a loose lime-green T-shirt, teal shorts, with no shoes, she carries vials of blood and empty syringes on her legs. Her messy purple hair, red eyes, and a "Welcome to Hell" label on her shirt, paired with a decently long tail, encapsulates her intriguing persona rooted in the folklore of blood-sucking entities like the tenkajin and chupacabra​.

Hisami Yomotsu, with an eerie demeanor contrasting her captivating appearance, is known for her relentless ability to grasp anything, essential for her role as a solicitor luring souls to Hell. Her design as a tall, beautiful woman with long jet-black hair and a distinctive purple headdress resembling a widow's veil, along with a purple china dress adorned with light purple leaves and grapevine, epitomizes her enigmatic yet enticing persona. Intricately tied to the youkai Yomotsu-Shikome lore, her narrative and aesthetic elements unveil a character of complex emotions and legendary associations​.

Zanmu Nippaku, initially a human monk, transformed into an oni after a self-induced fall to Hell, embracing her role as the ruler of Hell with a blend of intelligence and charisma. Her eerie calmness and grace in seeking peaceful resolutions juxtapose her relentless, cunning manipulations, employing her unique ability to drain desires and motivations from individuals, to orchestrate circumstances in her favor. Zanmu's design encapsulates her enigmatic persona with crimson eyes, long purple-black hair adorned with red-string-wrapped horns, dressed in a decorated green T-shirt and blue shorts. Her aesthetic, coupled with her convoluted ambitions and manipulative prowess, paints a picture of a complex antagonist maneuvering the intricacies of Hell's and Gensokyo's political landscapes.

Miyoi Okunoda, a zashiki-warashi residing in Geidontei, is known for her memory manipulation ability, particularly towards inebriated individuals. Sporting pink hair and green eyes, her attire includes a blue whale-shaped hat and apron, symbolizing Geidontei, alongside a light blue shirt and a purple skirt adorned with red and white papers resembling the Ibuki Gourd. As Geidontei's poster girl, she's seen delivering drinks, showcasing her friendly yet mischievous persona. Her name, translating to "beautiful evening," and her whimsical design, reflect her lively yet mysterious character​1.

Geidontei, translating to "whale drink pavilion," is a traditional Japanese-style bar nestled in the Human Village. Owned by an elder, it's marked by Miyoi Okunoda's presence as the poster girl, unaware to the owner, she's a Zashiki-warashi who resides there. While its patronage primarily consists of older individuals, it opens exclusively for Youkai post-hours under an agreement, hosting nocturnal gatherings known as Sanshoku Geidontei, attended by notable figures like Miyoi Okunoda, Suika Ibuki, Mamizou Futatsuiwa, and Aya Shameimaru. The establishment embodies a blend of tradition, secrecy, and unique camaraderie among the denizens of the realm​.

Zashiki-warashi are benevolent youkai, originating from Iwate Prefecture, known to inhabit households bringing good fortune to the residing family. However, their departure heralds bad fortune. These child-like entities, typically appearing as a child in a kimono with bobbed hair, require care akin to raising a child, ensuring they are not driven away. Known for causing harmless mischief, their presence in a household is cherished for the prosperity they bring​.

Mizuchi Miyadeguchi, a vengeful spirit capable of possessing people, seeks to unravel Gensokyo's order. With blue eyes and hair, she dons a white dress with red lines, black frills, and distinctive handcuffs linked to her neck. Her name, embodying elements of "shrine" and "exit," alongside "young spirit," mirrors her complex narrative as a spirit fleeing from Old Hell, drawing attention from Satori Komeji. Through her possession ability, Mizuchi manipulates her victims, leaving them with no memory of the possession, showcasing her as a formidable antagonist with a vendetta against Gensokyo's stability​1​
